title: RoutineTrigger — webhook
description: HMAC-verified webhook trigger. Mounted at /hooks/<path> on the deck server. Each delivery carries X-Routine-Timestamp: <unix seconds> and X-Routine-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<timestamp>.<raw body>")>; the MAC is checked over the exact request bytes in constant time, and a timestamp more than 300 seconds from the deck's clock is refused as a replay. Registrations made before signed deliveries also accept the bare secret as X-Routine-Signature (deprecated) until that is permanently turned off or the secret is rotated.

path.description: Public path on the deck server. Lowercase, kebab-case under /hooks/.

secret_env.description: Env var name, on the sender's side, holding the webhook secret (the HMAC key). The deck keeps the secret in routine_webhook_secrets to verify signatures and shows it only once, when POST /api/routines/:id/webhook-secret/rotate mints it.
